profile.headline: AI Enthusiast | Aspiring AI Developer | Computer Science & Technology Enthusiast
profile.heroDescription: Learning, building, and exploring the future of Artificial Intelligence and technology.
introduction: I am Muhammad Khan, a technology enthusiast from Shikarpur, Pakistan, passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, software development, and building meaningful digital solutions.
I enjoy exploring new technologies, learning programming, developing AI-powered applications, and solving real-world problems through technology.
My journey is driven by curiosity, continuous learning, creativity, and a vision to contribute to the future of technology.
aboutParagraphs: I am based in Shikarpur, Pakistan. I am passionate about technology, artificial intelligence, programming, and developing digital solutions.
I believe that learning should always be connected with practical experience. That is why I continuously explore new technologies, complete online courses, and develop projects.
I enjoy problem-solving, sharing knowledge, teaching mathematics, and helping people explore educational and career opportunities.

projects.title: DreamPath AI – AI-Powered Career Guidance Platform
projects.description:
I independently designed, developed, and deployed this live web application to help students in Pakistan discover suitable degrees, career paths, skills, and educational opportunities.

I worked on the design, development, and implementation of this platform using web technologies and Google AI Studio.

projects.title: Health Guide App
projects.description:
I designed and developed a digital health support application featuring AI integration, basic medical guidance, and user-friendly digital solutions.

My work included UI design, responsive web development, and AI integration.
